Live: harbour regatta final day

16:40

The final race is over and the blue boat takes the overall title by four seconds, a margin nobody predicted after the morning's results.

16:10

Wind has dropped to about eight knots at the outer mark, which favours the lighter crews, and the race committee has shortened the course by one leg.

15:30

Line-ups for the final: the blue boat starts on the pin end, the red boat in the middle, and the green boat near the committee vessel.

The green crew changed their bowman overnight after a wrist injury in yesterday's second race, according to their team manager.

14:55

Spectator boats are being moved back behind the buoy line, and the harbour master says the ferry timetable will run as normal all afternoon.
